verdict: The draft is faithful on promises, prices, numbers, Marina's testimonial and David's paragraph, and a scripted comparison of tags and numbers on all rows, plus the code skeleton of the JS rows, found no difference. Two rows must change (L131, L258) and four term decisions remain open (repertoire, the word for tracé, Emotional Feeling, enrichments).

L131.problem: The alt renames the notes: French Si and Ré become Ti and Re. The chart this alt describes uses the French note names, which stay untranslated, so the alt no longer matches what is shown. L132 carries the C D E version.
L131.evidence: source L126 'Do Ré Mi' and L305-L306 ['Ré',...], ['Si',...] are not in ids.txt, so they stay as they are. LEXIQUE section 4: note names are handled by the notation setting, not by translation.
L131.proposal: The same chord, each note in the colour of its chakra: Sol sky blue, Si violet, Ré orange.

L258.problem: 'elsewhere' reads as another place or device. In the app, 'ailleurs' for a scale means another key. The match between this page line and the app feature is a strong inference, not an identical string: 'ailleurs' appears in no offer line. The result sits close to L257, which is what the source already does.
L258.evidence: translations.ts L47455 v2.outils.transposer_gamme.desc 'Voir et écouter une gamme dans une autre tonalité' => 'See and hear a scale in another key.'; L47454 name 'Transpose a scale'; L47440 v2.outils.tonalite.desc 'ta gamme jouée comme si elle était ailleurs' => 'your scale played as if it were in another key'.
L258.proposal: • See and hear your scale in another key

L226.problem: Lexicon and consigne say library; the app mostly says repertoire, including in its navigation, and also uses songbook. The consigne gives two rules that conflict here (lexicon first, app first for screen names). 'The library' also sits close to the separate 'My library'. Decision needed; my reading favours repertoire.
L226.evidence: 93 parsed entries with French répertoire: 53 repertoire, 22 library (1 entry has both), the rest mainly songbook or other. Repertoire: L59761 navr.e.repertoire, L4113 logic.library_all, L35515 header.repertoire_title. Library: L11412 lib.music_library.le_repertoire, L33262 guide.section.le_repertoire. Songbook: L58014 rac.repertoire, L47679 v2.offres.f.repertoire. Separate item: L59757 'Ma bibliothèque' => 'My library'.
L226.proposal: Everything you need to get to know your instrument and play: your scale, your chords, the repertoire, singing to find your voice, playing technique, and saving what you create.

L149.problem: The app's usual English for tracé is path, here rendered as line. Same decision as L150 to L154.
L149.evidence: translations.ts L10831 'Le tracé de l'accord' => 'The chord path'; L8566 'Chord path'; L446 'Path Style'. Line also exists: L7733 'Style de tracé' => 'Line style', L7751 'Open-line path'.
L149.proposal: OpenA path that follows the route of the notes, so you can see a hand move.

L150.problem: 'hand line' does not occur in the app. The setting is called Hands, and its tracé is described as a path per hand.
L150.evidence: translations.ts L473 visual.path.hands 'Mains' => 'Hands'; L7760 'Tracé séparé par main' => 'Separate path for each hand'; L8854 'Separate paths for each hand'; L10376 'two paths, one per' hand.
L150.proposal: The same chord with one path per hand, acoustic handpan

L151.proposal: The same chord with one path per hand, digital pan

L152.problem: Same decision: tracé as line, while the app's Hands setting uses path.
L152.proposal: HandsThe path made for the movement. Which hand, which note: you read your playing straight off.

L153.problem: 'drawings' for tracés: the app does not use this noun for the three styles.
L153.evidence: translations.ts L446 'Path Style', L8800 'tracés' => 'lines', L8854 'paths'. No 'drawings' in the tracé entries returned by the search (first 25 of 71 read).
L153.proposal: The same chord with all three paths, on an acoustic D Kurd 18 handpan.

L154.proposal: The same chord, V Tension, with all three paths, on a Neotone.

L156.problem: The caption names a panel option, and the option in Logic mode reads Emotional Feeling. Other app text varies, so the choice needs confirming against the screenshot.
L156.evidence: translations.ts L1255 logic.emotion '❤️ Ressenti émotionnel' => '❤️ Emotional Feeling'; L7967 'Emotional feeling vocabulary'. Variants: L37921 'Emotional Feel', L26477 'Emotional response', L30537 'Emotional Experience'.

L168.problem: The app's usual word for enrichissements is enrichments. Extensions also exists in the app and is the normal musical word. Decide which one the page uses.
L168.evidence: translations.ts L35583 chord.enrich.some_tip 'Enrichissements possibles' => 'Enrichments available:'; 10 entries pair enrichissement with enrich-. Extension: L37054 g4.hc.extensions, L54825 ac.disp.ext.aide.
